notes.subject: bel
notes.rationale: לב is rendered bel per the glossary — heart/mind/will as the seat of feeling, not the physical organ

notes.subject: ושלל
notes.rationale: שלל is 'booty/spoil' — KJV 'no need of spoil' vs ASV/JPS 'no lack of gain'; rendered neutrally as samting we i kamap bilong em

notes.subject: בעלה
notes.rationale: בעל is 'master/owner'; rendered man bilong em (her husband), the Tok Pisin standard for husband

translation: Bel bilong man bilong em i stinghe long em, na em i no ken luspela olgeta samting we i kamap bilong em.

tokens.gloss: samting we i kamap bilong em
